productionDiffSinceBuild: No changes under plugins, features or product through reviewedHead
method: Verify existing external PRODUCT-MANIFEST.json, archive architecture directory with COPYFILE_DISABLE=1, extract into a new temporary directory, verify extracted product against extracted manifest. Checks bytes, file set, executable flag and link targets; clean-product guard runs before inventory verification.
limits: Archives created locally; no binary upload or remote old-asset replacement in this step
Integrity verification is not a signature, complete historical-scenario acceptance, or customer desktop-cloud certification
GUI evidence applies to the clean product tree before archiving, not a new GUI run from extracted archives
Runner self-tests are infrastructure tests and are not added to the DBeaver reactor pass count
External JDBC driver must be supplied separately; candidate is not a complete offline database connection kit
